MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(p.death_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) END AS end_year,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(p.death_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) END AS end_month,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 14 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(p.death_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) END AS end_day,
  CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH p,
  end_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
